description: Starting or resuming Stage 3 (--from-stage execute or --checkpoint) only merges origin/<target_branch> into context.plan_branch when admission.waited_since is set and can mask a stale plan_branch behind a prior failed execution_branch.
goal: Update Stage 3 plan refresh and pre-dispatch sync in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/stages/execute.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/plan_refresh.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/target_sync_hooks.py so starting or resuming Stage 3 (--from-stage execute or --checkpoint) checks whether origin/<target_branch> is an ancestor of context.plan_branch via git merge-base --is-ancestor and merges origin/<target_branch> into context.plan_branch before dispatch_executor runs, even when admission.waited_since is unset or a prior failed execution_branch is present, halting fail-closed on merge conflict before dispatching the executor container. Keep holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched and every module within its line limit. Add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_execute.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_plan_refresh.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_target_sync.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_target_sync_resume.py verifying uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Refreshing stale plan_branch onto origin/main unconditionally before Stage 3 dispatch eliminates wasted container runs and manual branch re-cuts when main advances.
acceptance_criteria: Starting or resuming Stage 3 (`--from-stage execute` or `--checkpoint`) checks whether `origin/<target_branch>` is an ancestor of `context.plan_branch` and merges `origin/<target_branch>` into `context.plan_branch` before `dispatch_executor`, even when `admission.waited_since` is unset or a prior failed `execution_branch` is present.
Merge conflicts during `plan_branch` refresh halt fail-closed before dispatching the executor container.

Hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/stages/test_execute.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_plan_refresh.py, apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_target_sync.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_target_sync_resume.py cover `--from-stage execute` after `origin/main` advances with and without a prior failed `execution_branch` (while keeping flow/stages/execute.py, flow/plan_refresh.py, and flow/target_sync_hooks.py within line budgets and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched); `uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
